policies.text: An item with production quality clearance receives flight authorization for controlled skyways if it registers at least 100 zero-incident operational hours quarterly.
Models possessing flight authorization for controlled skyways gain enrollment in the Enterprise Fleet Catalog when backed by $1,000,000 or more in annual commercial liability insurance coverage.
An appliance obtains the Green Home Energy designation if its annual energy consumption is no greater than 250 kWh.
A product secures placement in the Premium Retail Placement program provided its quarterly customer satisfaction score reaches at least 4.5 points.
A mobile device achieves international trade clearance if it retains an FCC regulatory permit and demonstrates a battery lifetime of 20 hours or more.
Commercial hardware achieves production quality clearance either by retaining an active ISO 9001 certification or by earning a flight safety score of at least 85 points on yearly evaluation.
Commercial software attains global export authorization when it maintains SOC 2 audit verification.
A hardware device receives military deployment clearance whenever it maintains military-grade durability compliance.
